hook_line: CHEVRON EARNINGS BEAT ESTIMATES AS REFINING LIFTS PROFIT TO $9.9 BILLION ON $67.8 BILLION REVENUE

stats.label: Revenue, up 36.3% and above the $60.5 billion consensus
Adjusted earnings per share, beating the $4.78 consensus by 10.5%
Downstream earnings, up from $1.1 billion a year earlier

diaspora_bullets: Free cash flow surged to $12 billion in the quarter
Total debt fell to $33.5 billion from $40.8 billion at the end of 2025
news_summary: Chevron reported third-quarter earnings of $9.9 billion, up from $3.5 billion a year earlier, as revenue rose 36.3% to $67.8 billion on a refining surge.
payoff: Chevron declared a $1.78 quarterly dividend payable December 10.
